content.summary: Research findings for: /changes sidebar collapsible tree, fuzzy filter, and keyboard-safe navigation

data.original_input: Explore implementation options for /changes sidebar enhancements: true collapsible directory nodes under staged/unstaged/untracked, fuzzy filename/path filter, preserved keyboard selection+diff behavior, and runtime verification for comment reset fix.

codebase_findings.topic: Sidebar data source and stage model
codebase_findings.details: FileList fetches sdk.client.file.status() and normalizes each entry into {id, path, added, removed, status, stage}. IDs are stage-qualified ("stage:path"), so the same file can appear in multiple stages without collisions.

codebase_findings.topic: Current grouping is directory headers, not collapsible nodes
codebase_findings.details: Grouping is computed per stage using dirname(path) buckets and rendered as static directory labels with all children always visible. There is no expand/collapse state and no nested tree structure.

Selection is index-based over a flat file list derived from groups(). A createEffect emits onSelect whenever selected() changes, which drives DiffPane loading. Mouse click sets index through an id->index map and calls choose() for explicit selection.

Three keyboard handlers are active in /changes: route-level (Shift+S submit, Esc close), file-list-level (up/down/j/k, Enter select, r refresh), and diff-pane-level (c comment). All are gated only by dialog.stack.length > 0.

codebase_findings.topic: Fuzzy-search prior art in this codebase
codebase_findings.details: The codebase already uses fuzzysort in TUI components and core file search. DialogSelect demonstrates local input + fuzzy ranking + selected-row behavior with keyboard navigation.
Submit currently clears comments with setComments(() => []) before navigation. This is the reported fix and is in the expected location.

prior_art: learn retrospective confirms /changes architecture is stable and suggests extracting FileList grouping to a pure transformer for testability: .agents/messages/2026-02-06T04-15-00Z-learn-retrospective.json
backlog item already exists for extraction: .agents/sdlc/backlog/extract-filelist-grouping-logic.md
session sidebar has proven expand/collapse UI pattern with chevrons and section state: packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/tui/routes/session/sidebar.tsx:24
patterns: A single derived flat 'visible rows' model is the safest bridge between tree UI and existing index-based keyboard selection.
Keep stage-qualified identity keys (stage:path) end-to-end to avoid cross-stage selection collisions.
When filters hide current selection, remap by selected id first, then fallback to nearest visible row to preserve diff continuity.
For TUI keyboard safety, explicit focus/edit mode flags are needed in addition to dialog-stack checks when adding inline input fields.
Collapse-state persistence should be key-based and pruned against current tree paths after refresh to satisfy AC-2.
raw_options: Inline refactor in file-list.tsx: add tree nodes + visible row projection + per-stage collapse map + fuzzysort filter.
Extract pure view-model transformer (tree + filter + visible rows) into a helper module, then keep file-list rendering thin.
Hybrid UX: keep static directory labels but add fuzzy filter and parent-path context only (defer true collapse).
Add dedicated filter-focus mode and explicit key routing (enter/esc/tab) to isolate typing from global /changes hotkeys.
Server-assisted filtering endpoint for very large repos (likely overkill for current ACs).
Incremental rollout: first collapsible tree with stable selection, then fuzzy filter on same row model.
Use existing DialogSelect mechanics as reference for local fuzzysort scoring and selected-row behavior.
Preserve current onSelect side effects by keeping file leaves as the only selectable rows and non-leaf rows toggle-only.
